Communications with Jia on August 28 2023

"That's correct. My dataset is in the gi_JH4327 directory; it should contain JH4318 and JH4327.

JH4318 and JH4327 are not replicates. JH4318 contains four different datasets that were done on July 11, 2023. JH4327 contains another three unique datasets that were done on July 26, 2023. In total, there should be seven (4+3) datasets that were sequenced. I updated the metafile on Google drive detailing each dataset. Plese download all of them.

Out of these seven datasets, JH4327_01 is the most important one because it is the replicate for the 1538Cre TE10 HE13 dataset. The 1538Cre TE10 HE13 dataset that you have been analyzing has MGE, POA, and Septum mixed together (which you computationally filtered) and were done with the MULTIseq method. This JH4327_01 dataset contains only MGE cells and was done with just the 10x scRNAseq method (not MULTIseq).
"

```{r}
# Load new datasets H13 dataset JH4327_01 containing 3525 cells (QCed by cell ranger) and perform basic QC



 # Load RNA counts
counts <- Read10X("C:/Users/karol/Box/Nord_Lab_Computational_Projects3/Jia_E13_1538_Aug_2023/JH4327_01/outs/filtered_feature_bc_matrix")

sample = "JH4327_01"

    # Create a Seurat object containing the RNA data
    pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(
        counts = counts,
        assay = "RNA"
    )

    # Check names of the mitochondrial genes
    # rownames(pbmc)[grepl("^mt-", rownames(pbmc), ignore.case = TRUE)]

    # Mitochondrial genes:
    DefaultAssay(pbmc) <- "RNA"
    pbmc[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(pbmc, pattern = "^mt-")

    # Violin plot - pre-filtering
    p1 <- VlnPlot(
        object = pbmc,
        features = c("nCount_RNA", "nFeature_RNA", "percent.mt"),
        ncol = 3,
        pt.size = 0.1)&
        theme(axis.text.x = element_blank())&
        plot_annotation(title = paste0(sample, ", Cellranger filtered cells.", " Features: ", nrow(pbmc),
                                       " Cells: ", ncol(pbmc)),
                        theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16, face = "bold")))


    p3 <- ggplot(pbmc@meta.data, aes(x = log2(nFeature_RNA),  y = log(nCount_RNA)))+
        geom_point(alpha = 0.1)+
        theme_bw()+
        labs(title = "Cellranger filtered cells")




    # Define QC filtering thresholds using 3 median absolute deviations.
    # This idea borrowed from the scater package

    #count_threshold_high <- median(pbmc@meta.data$nCount_RNA) + mad_distance*mad(pbmc@meta.data$nCount_RNA)
    #features_threshold_high <- median(pbmc@meta.data$nFeature_RNA) + mad_distance*mad(pbmc@meta.data$nFeature_RNA)
    #mito_threshold_high <- median(pbmc@meta.data$percent.mt) + mad_distance*mad(pbmc@meta.data$percent.mt)

    # This approach to filtering is not used here. To keep consistent criteria across multiple datasets
    # we decided to keep cells with > 1000 reads and < 20% mito reads
    mad_distance = 5

    pbmc[["nCount_RNA_abv_1000"]] <- pbmc@meta.data$nCount_RNA > 1000
    pbmc[["nCount_RNA_less_than_5_MADs"]] <- pbmc@meta.data$nCount_RNA <
                                             median(pbmc@meta.data$nCount_RNA) + mad_distance*mad(pbmc@meta.data$nCount_RNA)

    pbmc[["nCount_RNA_abv_1000_and_less_than_5_MADs"]] <- pbmc[["nCount_RNA_abv_1000"]] &
                                                          pbmc[["nCount_RNA_less_than_5_MADs"]]


    pbmc[["nFeature_RNA_abv_200"]] <- pbmc@meta.data$nFeature_RNA > 200
    pbmc[["nFeature_RNA_less_than_5_MADs"]] <- pbmc@meta.data$nFeature_RNA <
                                               median(pbmc@meta.data$nFeature_RNA) + mad_distance*mad(pbmc@meta.data$nFeature_RNA)

    pbmc[["nFeature_RNA_abv_200_and_less_than_5_MADs"]] <- pbmc[["nFeature_RNA_abv_200"]] &
                                                           pbmc[["nFeature_RNA_less_than_5_MADs"]]

    pbmc[["percent.mt_less_than_15"]] <- pbmc@meta.data$percent.mt < 15


    ######
    pbmc[["Cell_passing_QC"]] <- pbmc[["nCount_RNA_abv_1000_and_less_than_5_MADs"]] &
                                 pbmc[["nFeature_RNA_abv_200_and_less_than_5_MADs"]] &
                                 pbmc[["percent.mt_less_than_15"]]


    # Perform manual QC
    ## Filter out low quality cells
    pbmc <- subset(
        x = pbmc,
        subset =
            #nCount_RNA < count_threshold_high &
            nCount_RNA > 1000 &
            #nFeature_RNA < features_threshold_high &
            #nFeature_RNA > 200 &
            percent.mt < 20
    )


    # Violin plot - post-filtering
    p2 <- VlnPlot(
        object = pbmc,
        features = c("nCount_RNA", "nFeature_RNA", "percent.mt"),
        ncol = 3,
        pt.size = 0.1)&
        theme(axis.text.x = element_blank())&
        plot_annotation(title = paste0(sample, ", Quality filtered cells.", " Features: ", nrow(pbmc),
                                       " Cells: ", ncol(pbmc)),
                        theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16, face = "bold")))


    p4 <- ggplot(pbmc@meta.data, aes(x = log2(nFeature_RNA),  y = log(nCount_RNA)))+
        geom_point(alpha = 0.1)+
        theme_bw()+
        labs(title = "Quality filtered cells")



    # Save post filtering object
    saveRDS(pbmc, file = paste0("C:/Users/karol/Box/Nord_Lab_Computational_Projects3/Jia_E13_1538_Aug_2023/seurat_objects/", sample, "_QCed_Seurat_obj.rds"))


   top <-  plot_grid(p1, p2, ncol = 1)

   bottom <- plot_grid(p3, p4, ncol = 2)

   plot_grid(top, bottom, ncol = 1)
```

Integrate and cluster data
```{r}

# Rerun the integration pipeline to insure that all object slots are updated


# Add dataset IDs
pbmc_old$age <- ifelse(pbmc_old$dataset == "1538TE10H11", "E11", "E13")

pbmc$dataset <- "JH4327_01_TE10H13"
pbmc$age <- "E13"


# Initial clustering in the new data

pbmc <- SCTransform(pbmc, method = "glmGamPoi", verbose = FALSE)
pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc))


pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:25, verbose = FALSE)
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:25, verbose = FALSE)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, verbose = FALSE)

DimPlot(pbmc)
```




```{r}
# Create a list of objects and integrate
ifnb.list <- list(pbmc_old, pbmc)
ifnb.list <- lapply(X = ifnb.list, FUN = SCTransform)

features <- SelectIntegrationFeatures(object.list = ifnb.list, nfeatures = 3000)
ifnb.list <- PrepSCTIntegration(object.list = ifnb.list, anchor.features = features)


gc()

# Check the number of cells. If few cells are present adjust the k.weight parameter accordingly.
sapply(ifnb.list, function(x) ncol(x)) # 4438 + 3347 cells


plan("multicore", workers = 1) # Decrease the number of cores if running out of memory or "Error 2 (The system cannot find the file specified)" ?? I'm not sure what this error means, but it's triggered by FindIntegrationAnchors.
options(future.globals.maxSize = 30000 * 1024^2) # for 30 Gb RAM

RNA.anchors <- FindIntegrationAnchors(object.list = ifnb.list,
                                         normalization.method = "SCT",
                                         anchor.features = features)

# k.weight adjustment: https://github.com/satijalab/seurat/issues/3930
RNA_integrated <- IntegrateData(anchorset = RNA.anchors,
                                normalization.method = "SCT",
                                k.weight = 100)  # 100 is the default value

RNA_integrated <- RunPCA(RNA_integrated, verbose = TRUE, npcs = 30)

source("data_dims_simple.R")
data_dims_scree(RNA_integrated)


PCs = 25 # Determined empirically

pbmc <- RNA_integrated
rm(RNA_integrated)
rm(pbmc_old)

pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, verbose = FALSE, npcs = PCs)
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:PCs, verbose = FALSE)

# Recluster
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:PCs, verbose = FALSE)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, verbose = FALSE, graph.name = "integrated_snn")

DimPlot(pbmc)

DimPlot(pbmc, split.by = "dataset", label = TRUE, label.size = 8, pt.size = 1.1)
```

```{r}

#marker_DE, dev_class_int

marker_heatmap <- function(marker_DE, dev_class_int, title){

# Cluster genes
d <- subset(pbmc, dataset %in% c("1538TE10H11", "1538TE10H13", "JH4327_01_TE10H13"))@assays$SCT@counts

wl_genes <- marker_DE$gene_name[!grepl("mt-|Rps|Rpl", marker_DE$gene_name)]

top_positive <- filter(marker_DE, gene_name %in% wl_genes, avg_log2FC > 0)$gene_name[1:50]
top_negative <- filter(marker_DE, gene_name %in% wl_genes, avg_log2FC < 0)$gene_name[1:50]

d <- d[rownames(d) %in% c(top_positive, top_negative), ]
d <- as.matrix(d)


paletteLength <- 100
test <- as.matrix(d)

myBreaks <- c(seq(min(test), 0, length.out=ceiling(paletteLength/2) + 1),
              seq(max(test)/paletteLength, max(test), length.out=floor(paletteLength/2)))

myColor <- colorRampPalette(c("#9E0041", "#fea11d","#fea11d",
                              "white",
                              "#43abea", "#0a48aa", "#13008e"))(paletteLength)

# Cluster annotation
anno <- subset(pbmc, dataset %in% c("1538TE10H11", "1538TE10H13", "JH4327_01_TE10H13"))@meta.data
anno <- as.data.frame(anno[,c("dataset", "Dev_classes", "seurat_clusters", "age")])


anno$seurat_clusters <- factor(anno$seurat_clusters, levels = 0:max(as.numeric(pbmc@meta.data$seurat_clusters)))


d2 <- lapply(c("VZ", "SVZ", "MZ"), function(y){

        lapply(c("1538TE10H11", "1538TE10H13", "JH4327_01_TE10H13"), function(x){

    cells <- rownames(filter(anno, Dev_classes == y, dataset == x))
    as.data.frame(d)[, cells]

    })
    })


d21 <- do.call(cbind, c(d2[[dev_class_int]]))

# Work Zone
library(pheatmap)

d3 <- t(scale(t(d21)))
d3 <- ifelse(d3 > 3, 3, d3)
d3 <- ifelse(d3 < -3, -3, d3)

# VZ
VZ_pheatmap <- pheatmap(d3,
         fontsize = 8,
         show_rownames = T,
         show_colnames = F,
         labels_col = F,
         cluster_cols = F,
         clustering_distance_rows = "correlation",
         clustering_distance_cols = "correlation",
         method = "average",
         color = rev(myColor),
         annotation_col = anno,
         main = title)

}

```
